sectionIntro: A practical capability map—from network foundation to operational governance. Layer labels organize the work; they are not a literal OSI mapping.

layers.title: Routing & switching foundation
layers.summary: Build and troubleshoot resilient campus and data-center networks.

layers.title: Routing & security
layers.summary: Control paths, boundaries, and secure access across distributed environments.

layers.title: Cloud & WAN edge
layers.summary: Connect branches, remote users, and cloud workloads without sacrificing availability.

layers.title: Systems & identity
layers.summary: Operate the identity, naming, and host services that networks depend on.

layers.title: Observability & response
layers.summary: Turn telemetry into fast diagnosis, incident containment, and durable fixes.

layers.title: Governance & operations
layers.summary: Keep infrastructure controlled, recoverable, documented, and audit-ready.
